answer: Escalating bond ladder: the k-th account tied to one funding wallet locks 2k POA for 30 epochs, so an honest user pays 2 POA while 1,000 fakes lock 2 x 1,000 x 1,001 / 2 = 1,001,000 POA. Splitting across wallets fails because each needs coins from independent sources, and a shared upstream sender, like one exchange wharf, merges into one ladder. Each epoch 5% of accounts face a two-minute live challenge; failing forfeits 50% of the bond, so a comet of bots in one block loses fast, even a violet-tagged one. Slow, well-funded attackers still get in.
